# Teodor Bedrii (Teo Photos)

> Ukrainian photographer and videographer based in Madrid, Spain, available worldwide. Fashion, music and concert, DJ, dance, event, portrait and couple photography, plus short video and reels.

- Website: https://teophotosss.netlify.app/
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/teophotosss
- Email: teodorbedriy@gmail.com · WhatsApp: +34 607 327 378
- Languages: Ukrainian, English, Spanish, Polish, Russian

## Services and prices (EUR)
- Fashion / lookbook, portrait, couple shoots: see https://teophotosss.netlify.app/#prices
- Musicians: photo session €200 (up to 40 photos); concert photography from €250
- Dancers: photo €150, video €150, photo + video from €200
- Event coverage: €100 per hour; backstage and reels from €100
- All RAW files from any session: +€100

## Notable work
Photographed Tom Holland, Andriy Lunin, Sviatoslav Vakarchuk, Kalush Orchestra, Odyn v Kanoe. Bogotá Fashion Week. Worked with Lanes, Headway Inc, Beatmotiv, Svit Kavy, Teatro Monumental. Studies viola at the Real Conservatorio Superior de Música de Madrid.
